title: ASD Browser
lead: Browses the predicted effects of de novo noncoding variants from Simons Simplex Collection whole genomes, with disease impact tracks, per-variant molecular effects and a table of every variant.

pairs.caption: Default range in the genome browser
Heatmap with the tooltip on the selected variant, first row
pairs.input: chr1:2,337,101 A>C, iPS-20b Cell Line / H3K27me3, DNA features

differences.existing: Paper title as the heading; text says 127,140 autism proband mutations.
differences.proposed: ASD Browser heading with Study, Variants 127,133 (from the API), Genome GRCh37/hg19 and Paper Zhou et al., 2019.
differences.evidence: Both pages; the existing table page also says Results: 127133. Ask: which count is right for the headline?

differences.existing: View as table link opens a separate page, /dis_asd.
differences.proposed: Genome browser and Table switch on the same page (?view=table).
differences.evidence: Both pages; AsdPage.tsx

differences.existing: Location box in the browser toolbar; typing CHD8 there did not move the view in our test.
differences.proposed: Page search for a gene, region or position with Try examples; CHD8 moved to chr14:21,853,352-21,905,457 and a single position opens a 2 kb window.
differences.evidence: Both sites; AsdService.ts:86-96. Ask: should the existing toolbar accept gene names?

differences.existing: Zoom in, zoom out and a slider marked 200bp, 2kb, 50kb, 500kb.
differences.proposed: Zoom in, zoom out and four buttons: 200 bp, 2 kb, 50 kb, 500 kb.
differences.evidence: Both toolbars

differences.existing: Double arrow buttons jump to the next or previous feature in the selected track (DNA Disease Impact Score).
differences.proposed: Previous variant and Next variant step through the variants in view and change the selected one.
differences.evidence: Existing button titles; AsdExplorer.tsx:155-158

differences.existing: Buttons to add a track, configure tracks, export SVG and set options.
differences.proposed: None.
differences.evidence: Existing toolbar button titles; AsdExplorer.tsx:202 (trackActions false)

differences.existing: Same S3 files (dis_dna.bw, dis_rna.bw, gencode.bb); axis marks -0.5, 1 and 3.
differences.proposed: Same files drawn by our own engine; labelled Model score, -0.4 to 3, with the selected variant's value written on each track (3.43, 4.35).
differences.evidence: Network requests on both; AsdExplorer.tsx:39-44. Ask: is the track floor -0.4 or -0.5, and what unit is the score?

differences.existing: Address stays /asdbrowser/ while you move or select.
differences.proposed: Location, selected variant, view and feature set are kept in the address, so a view can be shared.
differences.evidence: Proposed URL after Next variant: ?variant=chr1:2346202; AsdPage.tsx

differences.existing: Heatmap (default) and Features tabs, with a DNA or RNA features dropdown.
differences.proposed: Strongest effects, Heatmap and All features tabs, opening on Heatmap as today, with the same DNA or RNA choice.
differences.evidence: Both pages; MolecularEffects.tsx:24-29

differences.existing: One column per variant, grouped with gaps by position, with rotated labels such as 2337101 A>C.
differences.proposed: One equal-width column per variant in genome order, joined to a position axis below; no column labels.
differences.evidence: Both heatmaps; AsdExplorer.tsx:293-313

differences.existing: Continuous blue to white to red, -3 to 3, so small values still show as pale tints.
differences.proposed: Seven steps; everything from -1 to 1 is one neutral grey, so many cells read as empty.
differences.evidence: Both heatmaps; EffectScale.ts:24-32 (edges 1, 2, 3 are placeholders). Ask: what unit and steps should the legend use?

differences.existing: Search features, Reverse sort, Full or Compact view, and a down arrow below the rows.
differences.proposed: None on the range heatmap; search exists only in Strongest effects and All features.
differences.evidence: Existing heatmap; EffectsCard.tsx:114. The down arrow did not change Showing top 20 in our test, so its purpose is to confirm.

differences.existing: Cell-type, Feature-type, Treatment, Position chr1:2337101 A>C, Score 7.1.
differences.proposed: Cell type / feature, Variant chr1:2,337,101 A>C, Score 7.11 with past the end of the legend (3); click pins it with Open in Genome Browser (UCSC).
differences.evidence: Hovered the same cell on both; Heatmap.tsx:269, GenomeLocation.ts:59-61. Treatment is not shown.

differences.area: Choosing a variant from the heatmap
differences.existing: Clicking a column label selects that variant and recentres the browser on it (1:2,241,201..2,451,203 for 2346202 G>T).
differences.proposed: Clicking a cell only pins the tooltip; the selection changes with Previous or Next variant, or from the table.
differences.evidence: Clicked a label on the existing page; clicked a cell on the proposed page and the selection stayed chr1:2,337,101

differences.existing: Features tab: every feature's score for the selected variant plotted by rank.
differences.proposed: All features tab, drawn with the shared all-features plot.
differences.evidence: Existing Features tab; EffectsCard.tsx (AllFeaturesPlot). Not compared screen by screen.

differences.existing: CHR, POSITION, Ref, Alt, Proband (check mark), Individual ID, both scores and genes, distance and four junction columns, all shown.
differences.proposed: Position (chr:pos), Change, Individual, both scores and genes, distance; the four junction columns hide under Columns. Scores of 1.5 or more are bold; blanks read Not available.
differences.evidence: Both table pages; AsdParts.tsx:176-216

differences.existing: Proband column marks probands (IDs ending p1) apart from siblings (s1).
differences.proposed: No Proband column and not offered under Columns.
differences.evidence: Existing table; AsdVariant.ts:46 lists Proband as shown but AsdParts.tsx never draws it

differences.existing: Free-text search on any column or a position; CHD8 gave 3 results.
differences.proposed: Chromosome filter and Only the genome browser's range; the page search moves the range instead of filtering text.
differences.evidence: Searched CHD8 on /dis_asd; AsdParts.tsx:163-166. Ask: is text search across columns needed?

differences.existing: Clicking a gene cell did not open the browser in our test.
differences.proposed: Each position is a button that opens the browser at that variant.
differences.evidence: Both tables; AsdParts.tsx:196-199

differences.existing: Download data fetches dis_asd.tsv from S3; the data-use notice is plain text.
differences.proposed: Download data opens the same dis_asd.tsv in a new tab; the notice is a dismissible alert remembered in this browser.
differences.evidence: Both link to s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/humanbase/variants/dis_asd.tsv; AsdExplorer.tsx:119, AsdParts.tsx:54-58
